description: Search the mcp.film directory of MCP servers for AI filmmaking. Filter by free-text query (matches name, vendor, tagline, description, capabilities, tools, category, pricing, auth, and the creative apps a server drives by name or alias, e.g. 'c4d' or 'resolve'), category id, or capability. Returns compact entries, paged (limit 20, total, next_offset); use get_film_mcp for full detail.

answering_only.description: Only listings whose hosted endpoint answered mcp.film's anonymous MCP check in the last 7 days (evidence: endpoint_answered; a sign-in challenge counts as answering).

include_inactive.description: Also return listings whose status is dead, archived or deprecated. Default false.

offset.description: Start index for paging; use next_offset from the previous call.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'upscale video' or 'voice cloning'

remote_only.description: Only hosted remote MCPs (no local install)

name: search_film_mcps
title: Search film MCP servers
